key_insight: For the scheduling instance and initialization studied, an entanglement-free variational quantum ansatz found feasible schedules without a solution-quality benefit from entanglement.
engineering_relevance: The approach models multi-skilled workforce scheduling with capacity, priority, deadline, and rescheduling-stability considerations while limiting each daily batch to at most 30 qubits.
method: Formulate multi-skill resource-constrained project scheduling as a QUBO.
Solve one day at a time, propagate remaining workload, and use logarithmic binary encoding.
Compare linear and brick-wall entangling ansätze against a parameter-matched entanglement-free reference using COBYLA and Adam with SPSA gradients.
evidence_signal: In simulation, the entanglement-free reference yielded feasible schedules with both optimizers; with COBYLA, it came closest to the required workload at a fraction of the entangled configurations’ simulation cost.
watch_item: Results are limited to the studied instance and initialization and do not establish quantum advantage or performance on physical quantum hardware.
paper_title: A Variational Quantum Algorithm for Multi-Skill Project Scheduling
